description: This Java class handles the rejection of fixed deposit account applications within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface to process commands that reject a fixed deposit application, delegating the rejection logic to the DepositApplicationProcessWritePlatformService.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountApplicationRejectedCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the rejection of fixed deposit account applications; processes commands to reject applications.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the reject application command by calling the deposit account write platform service to reject the application.
